⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. `finding` comes off.

- **p1,** like its report twin objectui#13470: a valid `PageSchema.label` (`I18nLabel`) blanks the route for every viewer.
- **Route:** `AppHeader.tsx`'s page branch resolves the label through `metadataText` in the viewer's language, as objectui#13487 does for the report branch. It may ride #13487 if that PR is still open. Otherwise it gets its own PR on the same helper, and the page heading plus any other raw `pageDef.label` print are swept in it.

Premise: holds — on objectui `main` `85b6a48`, `AppHeader.tsx:698–699` passes `pageDef?.label` as the fallback to `pageLabel()`, which returns an untranslatable fallback untouched, so a map reaches the render (React #31)

- **Must:** resolve the page label through the same `metadataText` path the report branch uses; the slug stays the fallback when no label resolves. Pin: an inline-locale map renders the viewer's-locale string, and a plain string is unchanged.
- **Sweep:** other `AppHeader` branches (object, dashboard, …) with the same shape go in this PR only if the fix is the identical call; otherwise list them in the report.

Claim amendment · `domain:ui#4` · 2026-10-25T04:00Z · amends claim `6393173731`

**File surface widened, on the dev's measurement:** add `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`, one test under `packages/components/src/__tests__/`, and an `@object-ui/components` patch line in the changeset.

Why: the card's Expected says to check the page's own heading too. `PageRenderer` draws `schema.title ?? schema.label` as the implicit h1 and `schema.description` raw; both are `I18nLabel` in `PageSchema`. It also hands the raw description to `page:header` through `PageDescriptionContext`. The dev probed `main` `85b6a48` with the real `SchemaRenderer` + `PageRenderer` (not committed). All three legs threw React #31: a map label, a map description, and a titled `page:header` with a map description. So an AppHeader-only fix still leaves the route blank. The fix there is `pickLocalized(value, language)` from `@object-ui/i18n`, the resolver `page:header` and `elements.tsx` in the same package already use.

Also in surface (the claim's sweep clause): AppHeader's dashboard branch has the identical shape (`dashboardDef?.label || …` into the phone-bar title; `DashboardSchema.label` is `I18nLabel`), fixed by the same one-call `metadataText` change.

Serial constraints re-checked: seat 1's objectui#13449 holds `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/**`, not `renderers/layout/**`; no other open claim names `page.tsx`. Clause-② and Metadata-protocol are unchanged (no / none).
